# OPB - Oregon Public Broadcasting

> > Oregon Public Broadcasting (OPB) is a nonprofit public media organization serving the Pacific Northwest through television, radio, and digital platforms, supported by member contributions and editorial partnerships.

OPB operates multiple media channels including OPB TV, OPB Radio, and KMHD Jazz Radio, serving Oregon, Washington, and the broader Pacific Northwest region. The organization has recently navigated federal funding elimination and emphasizes community engagement, regional journalism, and partnership-driven content creation.
